subject: Apollo CAIQ intake - availability, pre-read, and call notes
messages:
From: Ana Patel <ana.patel@apollo.io>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: tom.nguyen@apollo.io
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: CAIQ intake and quick intro call

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Apollo Therapeutics is starting our vendor assessment for clinical data handling and we flagged Redwood for a CAIQ/SIG intake so our security team can validate architecture and controls. Two quick asks before we hop on a call:

1) Can you share a short pre-read (network diagram + high-level CAIQ answers) so our reviewers can pre-triage items?
2) We're hoping to schedule a 45-minute intake this week or next — typical agenda: CAIQ walkthrough, evidence owners, and a short demo of log/export mechanics.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Nov 3, 10:00–10:45
- Wed Nov 4, 14:00–14:45

Also: our procurement lead Tom (cc'd) may have a procurement checklist to run through; please include any redlines or contract-related items we should expect.

Questions we already flagged: data residency options for Private deployment, sample telemetry/log retention, and whether you provide redacted sample logs for intake.

Thanks,
Ana Patel
Security Programs Lead, Apollo Therapeutics
Attachments: none
From: mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ana Patel <ana.patel@apollo.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-01T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ intake and quick intro call

Hi Ana — great to connect. Thanks for outlining the ask. We're available for Tue Nov 3 at 10:00 PST and will plan a 45-minute slot. I'll send a calendar invite after you confirm.

I've attached a short pre-read: a draft CAIQ answer workbook and our current network architecture snapshot. Quick notes so your reviewers have context:
- redwood-caiq-draft-answers-v1.xlsx: draft responses (section owners annotated)
- redwood-network-arch-v2026-10.pdf: depiction of hosted vs. private deployment flows

Owners (internal):
- Encryption & key mgmt: Irene Choi
- Logging, retention, and sample artifacts: Marissa Cole
- Contract/procurement follow-ups: me (I'll triage with legal)

Proposed 45-minute agenda:
1) 5m intro + scope
2) 20m CAIQ highlights and problem areas (pre-flagged Qs)
3) 10m evidence artifact discussion (what we can publish vs. what needs redaction)
4) 10m open Q&A and next steps/action owners

A couple quick answers to your flagged questions:
- Data residency: private deployments can be pinned to a region; hosted customers can request region constraints via Dedicated reservations (we'll confirm specifics on the call).
- Sample logs: we can provide redacted samples; Marissa will bring the redaction workflow and a retention excerpt.

If that looks good, confirm the Tue slot and we'll send an invite.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-caiq-draft-answers-v1.xlsx; redwood-network-arch-v2026-10.pdf
From: mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-02T08:20:00-08:00
Subject: Prep: Apollo CAIQ intake (Tue 11/3 10:00 PST)

Irene / Marissa — looping you in as owners for the intake. Meeting is Tue 11/3 10:00 PST (confirmed by Apollo). Brief checklist for prep:

Irene (Encryption & KMS):
- Review CAIQ sections A.5 (Key Mgmt) and A.7 (Cryptography) in the draft workbook; add short bullets for our KMS integrations (HSM/KMS partners) and default encryption-at-rest posture.
- Prepare 1 slide (or 2 bullet points) covering bring-your-own-key options for Private deployments.

Marissa (Logging & Evidence):
- Prepare a one-paragraph summary of log retention defaults and the process for producing redacted samples; attach the log-retention-excerpt.txt to the intake packet.
- Confirm whether we can produce a 7-day sample slice for demo and what fields are redacted by default.

Me: I'll own procurement and overall run of show, and will have a HubSpot link and the contract intake checklist ready.

Keep answers short — the reviewers prefer concise definitive statements rather than long essays. I'll collect final edits to the workbook by EOD Monday.

Thanks,
Mateo

---
Internal note: Marissa / Irene, if either of you need a quick sync before Monday EOD, I'm free 1–2pm tomorrow.
From: Ana Patel <ana.patel@apollo.io>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: tom.nguyen@apollo.io
Date: 2026-11-03T07:58:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ intake and quick intro call — confirmed

Thanks Mateo — Tue 11/3 10:00 PST works for our team. Tom and I will attend plus a technical reviewer (Sagar, cc'ing offline if he can join). A couple additional asks ahead of the call:

- Procurement: Tom has a short vendor checklist and would appreciate an SOW template or indication of standard commercial terms (if available).
- Data residency detail: can you confirm whether Hosted customers can restrict inference to EU-only regions today (we understand Dedicated/Private has stronger guarantees)?
- Compliance scope: please confirm if SOC 2 Type II is in scope for the hosted API (we'll want the attestation date and where it is hosted).

We have uploaded our intake packet to the Drive folder and added a short questionnaire — link below. If you can pre-populate any high confidence fields in the CAIQ workbook before attendees arrive it will speed the call.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-apollo/CAIQ-intake (Apollo shared folder)

Best,
Ana

Tom Nguyen
Procurement Manager, Apollo Therapeutics
From: mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ana Patel <ana.patel@apollo.io>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@apollo.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, irene.choi@redwoodinference.com, jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-19T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Apollo CAIQ intake - meeting notes, artifacts shared, and next steps

Hi Ana / Tom — thanks again for the call last week. Quick recap and action register from our intake session (concise):

Attendees: Ana Patel (Apollo), Tom Nguyen (Apollo), Sagar (Apollo reviewer - partial), Mateo Alvarez (Redwood), Marissa Cole (Redwood), Irene Choi (Redwood), Jordan Blake (Redwood - legal)

Key points discussed:
- Scope: CAIQ for Hosted API + Private deployment options. Confirmed that SOC 2 Type II is maintained for our hosted service; latest attestation date: 2026-08-15.
- Data residency: Hosted API currently offers region-level routing (EU/US); Dedicated/Private provide stronger contractual region guarantees. Jordan will follow up with exact contractual language for EU-only inference.
- Logging & samples: We demonstrated redaction pipeline. Marissa confirmed we can deliver a redacted 7-day sample log (PII removed) and provided the log-retention-excerpt.txt as a stub.
- KMS/Encryption: Irene outlined our KMS integrations and BYOK for Private deployments.

Artifacts shared (links/attachments):
- redwood-caiq-draft-answers-v1.xlsx (attached) — we pre-populated high-confidence fields; please flag anything you want updated.
- redwood-network-arch-v2026-10.pdf (attached) — architecture for hosted vs private.
- log-retention-excerpt.txt (attached) — short excerpt of logging policy and retention windows.
- HubSpot intake: HS-987654 (I'll add the procurement checklist there).

Action items:
- Jordan Blake (Redwood legal) — by 2026-11-24: provide the draft EU-only inference clause and sample SOW language for procurement review.
- Marissa Cole (Redwood) — by 2026-11-22: deliver a redacted 7-day sample log to Apollo's secure bucket (Ana to confirm access).
- Irene Choi (Redwood) — by 2026-11-22: add BYOK implementation notes to CAIQ workbook (A7) and confirm HSM partners.
- Ana (Apollo) — by 2026-11-23: confirm whether Sagar will run the detailed CAIQ review and share any priority sections.

Next step: I'll push updated CAIQ workbook to the shared Drive folder and ping when Jordan's legal language is available. Please reply-all if any of the bullets above need to be corrected.

Best regards,
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-caiq-draft-answers-v1.xlsx; redwood-network-arch-v2026-10.pdf; log-retention-excerpt.txt
